searchText: True, but you can use built in browser tools (edit and resend in network tab) to do it. You can also use something like curl for one-off testing or data gathering. Please add any spec known to you here: https://github.com/ethereum-oasis/eth1.x-JSON-RPC-API-standard/issues/4 With transcoder you still pay the price of having to manually implement JSONRPC server. The best route is to bury JSONRPC and write the API spec in gRPC protobuf
